messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (truth‑conditions) | Target Word / Phrase (Tamil) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|------------------------------------------|------------------------------|----------------------------|--------| | ove | “where” – locative introducer of the clause | **அங்கு** | “there” | OK | | udirai | future action “you will hear” | **கேட்பீர்கள்** | “you will hear” | OK | | le | definite article, fem. pl (marks *strida*) | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | disperate | “despairing” – attribute of the shrieks | **துயரமான** | “despairing” | OK | | strida | plural noun “shrieks” – object of *udirai* | **கத்தல்களை** | “shrieks (pl.)” | OK | | vedrai | future action “you will see” | **காண்பீர்கள்** | “you will see” | OK | | li | definite article, masc. pl (marks *spiriti*) | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | antichi | “ancient” – temporal attribute of *spiriti* | **பழமையான** | “ancient” | OK | | spiriti | plural noun “spirits” – object of *vedrai* | **ஆவிகளை** | “spirits (pl.)” | OK | | dolenti | “woeful” – predicative of *spiriti* | **துயரமுள்ள** | “woeful” | OK | | ch’ (che) | relative pronoun “who” introducing clause about *spiriti* | **அவர்கள்** | “they / who” | OK | | a | preposition “to/toward” – direction of the shout | — (implicit in verb) | — | UNNECESSARY | | la | definite article, fem. sg (marks *morte*) | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | seconda | ordinal “second” – attribute of *morte* | **இரண்டாவது** | “second” | OK | | morte | noun “death” – object of the preposition | **மரணத்தை** | “death (obj.)” | OK | | ciascun | distributive quantifier “each” – applies to *spiriti* | **ஒவ்வொருவரும்** | “each (person)” | OK | | grida | verb “shouts / proclaims” – action of each spirit | **அறிவிக்கிறார்கள்** | “announce / proclaim” | OK |
---
### Items Flagged
- **UNNECESSARY**: `le`, `li`, `la` (Italian definite articles have no direct counterpart in Tamil and are naturally omitted). - **UNNECESSARY**: `a` (the directional preposition is absorbed by the Tamil verb *அறிவிக்கிறார்கள்* “announce/proclaim”).
No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Tamil script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 115: - Original: அங்கு நீங்கள் துயரமான கத்தல்களை கேட்பீர்கள், - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 116: - Original: நீங்கள் பழமையான துயரமுள்ள ஆவிகளை காண்பீர்கள், - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 117: - Original: அவர்கள் ஒவ்வொருவரும் இரண்டாவது மரணத்தை அறிவிக்கிறார்கள்; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
``` அங்கு நீங்கள் துயரமான கத்தல்களை கேட்பீர்கள், நீங்கள் பழமையான துயரமுள்ள ஆவிகளை காண்பீர்கள், அவர்கள் ஒவ்வொருவரும் இரண்டாவது மரணத்தை அறிவிக்கிறார்கள்; ```
